children: Miami International Holdings said its FCM, Dorman Trading, became an OCC clearing member and that it increased the FCM’s net capital by $40M, to approximately $68M as of Aug. 31, 2026, to support growth and trading in its Bloomberg equity index futures.
FCM now an OCC clearing member
Cuts clearing costs/complexity for clients, potentially boosting futures volumes and MIAX ecosystem stickiness.
Strengthens balance sheet to onboard more clients and withstand market stress; supports growth.
Indicates scale and regulatory cushion; capacity for higher clearing activity.
Could accelerate adoption of new MIAX Futures products if clients gain efficiency.

This extends MIAX’s push to build a futures franchise around new Bloomberg index contracts, moving from launch to scaling infrastructure. A larger catalyst would require evidence of rising open interest/volumes and new client wins attributable to OCC membership and added capital.
Based on the original press release from Miami International Holdings, Inc. distributed by PR Newswire.
